scope.notes: The work spans ChecksStudioPage, CompileReviewPanel, StepReviewList, review state tests, accessibility tests, and likely focused component tests.

integration.notes: No new API or external integration is permitted; existing Studio API data and the useCompileReview lifecycle remain authoritative.

infrastructure.notes: No deployment, schema, service, or dependency change is required.

knowledge.notes: Existing MUI and React patterns are known, but implementation must understand the candidate-artifact, confirmation, diagnostics, and accessibility invariants.

risk.notes: This affects the confirmation safety control and day-to-day operational workflow. A UX simplification must not weaken exact-revision or artifact-truth guarantees.

flags: Do not reintroduce client-side translation parsing or code generation.
Maintain existing diagnostics alignment and accessibility behavior.
